# Paddle OpenAPI spec (vendored)

`v1/openapi.yaml` is Paddle's own OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Paddle
API, vendored from
[github.com/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi](https://github.com/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi)
— auto-generated by Paddle whenever they release API changes, per that
repo's own README.

- **Source commit:** `540ea17369325ff866b65ecf6c5105592f16fb5d`
- **Fetched:** 2026-09-03

Pinned deliberately, not fetched live at build/test time — same reasoning
as pinning `golangci-lint` in CI rather than installing `@latest`:
reproducibility over always-current. `internal/client/contract_test.go`
diffs this provider's Go client structs against it; a Paddle API change
that actually matters to this provider won't be caught until this file is
refreshed.

## Refreshing

```sh
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi/main/v1/openapi.yaml \
  -o third_party/paddle-openapi/v1/openapi.yaml
```

Then update the commit SHA/date above (check
`https://api.github.com/repos/PaddleHQ/paddle-openapi/commits/main`), and
run `go test ./internal/client/...` — any drift the refreshed spec reveals
needs a real decision (the provider's model was wrong, or the field is
deliberately unmodeled and belongs on `contractIgnore` in
`contract_test.go`), not a reflexive edit to make the test pass.
